parsed.rationale: Both `WXYCApp.navigateToPreviousTheme` (line 465) and `WXYCApp.navigateToNextTheme` (line 477) live in the same file (`WXYC/iOS/WXYCApp.swift`) and share a Jaccard similarity of 0.75, indicating their bodies are structurally nearly identical. The only meaningful difference is the navigation direction, which is already encoded in their names. Introducing a single `navigateTheme(direction:)` or `navigateTheme(offset:)` helper removes the duplicated logic while keeping the two public entry-points as thin, readable wrappers. Neither method is test, codegen, mock, or sample-app code, so there is no intentional-duplication rationale.

specifics.proposed_action: Unify `WXYCApp.navigateToPreviousTheme` (line 465) and `WXYCApp.navigateToNextTheme` (line 477) in `WXYC/iOS/WXYCApp.swift` into a single private helper method — e.g., `navigateTheme(direction: ThemeNavigationDirection)` or `navigateTheme(offset: Int)` — where the direction/offset parameter encodes whether to step forward or backward. Both call sites become one-liners delegating to the shared helper, eliminating the near-duplicate body (Jaccard 0.75).
